A.brief_rationale: Correctly states the flushed zone may extend only a few inches, justifying very shallow investigation. It also says a sidewall pad is used to avoid borehole effects, but omits the pad-pressed-against-formation / mud short-circuit minimization and current path detail.

B.brief_rationale: Correctly states the flushed zone may extend only a few inches, justifying very shallow investigation. It also says a sidewall pad is used to avoid borehole effects, but omits the pad-pressed-against-formation / mud short-circuit minimization and current path detail.

C.brief_rationale: Correctly states the flushed zone may extend only a few inches, justifying very shallow investigation. It also says a sidewall pad is used to avoid borehole effects, but omits the pad-pressed-against-formation / mud short-circuit minimization and current path detail.

D.brief_rationale: Gives the general idea that Rxo is a near-borehole shallow target and that the pad helps measure near the wall, but does not state the key supported detail that the flushed zone may extend only a few inches. It also misses the explicit borehole/mud short-circuit reduction role and adds unsupported specifics about deeper zones and Rt mixing.

E.brief_rationale: Does not correctly explain that the flushed zone may extend only a few inches from the borehole. It includes a materially false statement describing the flushed zone as formed by groundwater flow around the core. The sidewall pad explanation is only partial and misses the borehole/mud short-circuit reduction detail.
